_note: Single-source (late-antique to early-medieval Norse/viking). Norse sub-palette of the Germanic family; sea-raiders and herders of tundra, taiga and glacial mountains ('Vargari' < vargr = wolf/outlaw). clan = clanhold (jarls, hersirs and the thing). Even split Neutral/Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Norse register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Norse-branch reflexes of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json), phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Norse gods (no Odin/Thor/Freyja).

phonology.palette: Old Norse: nominative -r; initial w- lost before round vowels; ai>ei, au>ey; th/dh; i- and u-umlaut; -son/-dottir; theophoric stems are the Norse reflexes (Thulr-, Orlund-, Nymir-, Rjalta-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and clusters (sk, st, hv, hl, hr, fj, kn); root-initial stress.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -son / -dottir (X's son/daughter); clan (aett) for the great houses; bynames common.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (jarls, hersirs and the thing; the konungr is first among chieftains)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Norse clanhold, ascending. Hauldr (yeoman-lord) barony; Markvordr (march-warden) march; Hersir (district-chief) county; Jarl (earl) duchy; Fylkir (folk-king) principality; Konungr (king) kingdom; Yfirkonungr (over-king) empire over the Storriki. The thing-assembly checks the konungr. (Rank titles are the real Norse register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal + -son/-dottir patronymic; a byname (deed, animal, or trait) for the renowned.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the jarl-kin add an aett and a war-byname; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the Norse deity-reflexes + an element: -ulfr (wolf), -bjorn (bear), -mundr (protector): e.g. Thulr-ulfr, Orlund-mundr.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Norse-branch reflexes of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json) - phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Norse gods (no Odin/Thor/Freyja/Loki/Baldr). Neutral and Chaotic: Neutral kin honor the ancestral dead and land-wights; the war-bands swear by the storm and wolf powers.
religion.the_one: Eitnir (< *Aiternaz < Aeternus; the far All-Father, beyond the gods' reach)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the wild and grasping powers keep their Norse reflexes + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hof (temple) or Ve (sacred enclosure) of [power]: 'the Hof of Nymir'.
religion.saints_pattern: the howe-dwelling ancestors and land-wights honored at the grave-howe and the holy fell.

holy_symbol_motifs.Nymir: a storm-eye between two ravens over an ash-tree

banks_patterns.military_units: the [chief] hird / the [animal] berserkir: 'the Wolf-coats', 'the Storm-Raven hird'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: haunted howes and ice-locked halls: 'the Howe of [name]', 'the Draugr-hall of [name]'
